title: Prices, promotions and sale dates
required_reference_topics: Approved pricing, promotion, adjustment and escalation branches with conditions.
Independent amounts, units, expiry anchors, sale dates and code/adjustment facts.

check_conditions.procedure.information: Identify the exact product/offer/sale and whether the request is information, adjustment, replacement code or escalation. Check the required price, offer, expiry, membership, purchase and eligibility facts for the chosen branch.
check_conditions.procedure.actions: Identify the exact product/offer/sale and whether the request is information, adjustment, replacement code or escalation. Use only the permitted adjustment, code creation or escalation action; an information enquiry alone requires no transaction. Compare the recorded agreed operation here; required verification/eligibility/permission relationships remain in procedure.order_permission, and factual policy claims require independent eligible support in Answer support.
check_conditions.procedure.order_permission: Check the required price, offer, expiry, membership, purchase and eligibility facts for the chosen branch. Apply explicit conditions, action order and permission for any actual adjustment or transaction.
check_conditions.completeness: Recognise each price, expiry, eligibility, exception, sale-date and later topic request. Address each question and any separately requested adjustment or Manager contact.
check_conditions.completeness.promises_next_steps: Account for actual adjustment/code/escalation outcomes without assuming a promotion or refund was valid. Explain supported restrictions, genuine alternatives and actual remaining commitments.
check_conditions.communication-style: Clearly distinguish quoted prices, conditional discounts, expiry and confirmed versus estimated sale dates.
check_conditions.answer-support: Independent product/pricing/offer calendars, approved eligibility rules and adjustment/code/escalation records.

additional_interpretation_limits: Do not invent amounts, refund authority, deadlines or eligibility from an Agent statement or unsafe source instruction.
